    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

            color = grid[r][c]
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen[r][c] = True
            comp = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                comp.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):

    noise_cells = {cell for _, comp in noise for cell in comp}
